setup_cancelled: Last line of setup after the person backs out of the settings screen.

wizard_next_no_host_body: Next-step card text after a client install.
wizard_next_host_link: Link on a next-step card: the Windows host docs.
tray_status_not_installed: First line of the tray menu and the icon's tooltip. 'punktfunk host' names the program.
tray_status_stopped: First line of the tray menu and the icon's tooltip. 'punktfunk host' names the program.
tray_status_starting: First line of the tray menu and the icon's tooltip. 'punktfunk host' names the program.
tray_status_degraded: First line of the tray menu and the icon's tooltip. 'punktfunk host' names the program.
tray_status_failed: First line of the tray menu and the icon's tooltip. 'punktfunk host' names the program.
tray_status_streaming_mode: First line of the tray menu and the icon's tooltip. 'punktfunk host' names the program. {version}: the host's version; {width}×{height}@{fps}: the stream's size and frame rate, numbers.
tray_status_streaming: First line of the tray menu and the icon's tooltip. 'punktfunk host' names the program. {version}: the host's version.
tray_status_idle_kept: First line of the tray menu and the icon's tooltip. 'punktfunk host' names the program. {version}: the host's version; {count}: virtual displays the host keeps after a stream.
tray_status_idle: First line of the tray menu and the icon's tooltip. 'punktfunk host' names the program. {version}: the host's version.
tray_release_displays: Tray menu item: open the console's displays page to release kept virtual displays. {count}: how many.
tray_open_console: Tray menu item: open the web console in the browser.
tray_open_console_down: Tray menu item while the console does not answer.

tray_unit_stop: Linux tray submenu item: stop this one service.
tray_unit_restart: Linux tray submenu item: restart this one service (not the computer).
tray_approve_pairing: Tray menu item while a device waits for approval; opens the console's pairing page.
tray_start_host: Tray menu item: start the stopped host (and on Linux its console and plugin runner).
tray_start_at_login: Linux tray checkbox: start the tray when you log in.
tray_exit: Tray menu item: close the tray icon; the host keeps running.
tray_toast_connected: Windows notification when a stream starts. {name}: the client's name.
tray_toast_client_connected: Windows notification title when a stream starts and the client has no name.
tray_toast_streaming: Windows notification body when the size is unknown.
tray_stop_host: Windows tray menu item: stop the host service (asks for administrator rights).
tray_open_logs: Windows tray menu item: open the host's log folder.
tray_stop_and_exit: Windows tray menu item while the host runs: stop it, then close the tray.
